'''Shadow wing''' was a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|wing]] within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="JKTCG" /> One of Shadow wing's [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] was [[PS-29-2]]&mdash;nicknamed "Mynock"&mdash;who flew under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of [[Shadow Two (Shadow wing)|Shadow Two]], operating and tweaking the control systems of<ref name="JKTCG2">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=PS-29-2 • "Mynock"|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73022/cid/5265139/2001-Decipher-Jedi-Knights-TCG:-Premiere-61R-PS-29-2---}}</ref> a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/LN]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used to enforce [[Blockade/Legends|blockades]], which had exquisite handling for slashing attacks on unescorted [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].<ref name="JKTCG3">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=Shadow Two|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/73022/cid/5265142/2001-Decipher-Jedi-Knights-TCG:-Premiere-63R-Shadow-Two?PageIndex=1}}</ref> [[PS-29-3]]&mdash;nicknamed "Hammer"&mdash;was another [[TIE pilot]] of Shadow wing.<ref name="JKTCG4">{{JKTCG|set=Premiere|cardname=PS-29-3 • "Hammer"|link=http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/cardlists/premier/large/62Ups293hammer.html}}</ref> Flying under the call sign of [[Shadow Three (Shadow wing)|Shadow Three]],<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|48|PS-29-3}}</ref> PS-29-3 intended to eventually lead Shadow wing,<ref name="JKTCG4" /> and likewise his starfighter had a command system capable of coordinating the entire Shadow wing's combined power.<ref name="JKTCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Shadow wing was created in [[2001]]'s [[Premiere (Jedi Knights TCG)|''Premiere'']] expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s ''[[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]]''. While it was simultaneously introduced by the cards for Shadow Three,<ref name="JKTCG" /> PS-29-3,<ref name="JKTCG4" /> Shadow Two,<ref name="JKTCG3" /> and PS-29-2,<ref name="JKTCG2" /> only the first<ref name="JKTCG" /> and second card in this sentence mentioned the wing by name.<ref name="JKTCG4" />
